summary: Centene Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a partial redemption of $500 million of its 4.25% Notes due 2027. The redemption date is August 13, 2026, with $568.664 million remaining outstanding. The redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued interest. This is a routine debt management action, not a special situation such as an acquisition or strategic review. The filing is a standard notice of partial redemption, with no special-situation implications.
